faq.looks: An optional heading above a stack of question rows that open to show their answers.
faq.use: Questions and answers, or any set of topics where readers need only some of the answers.
faq.avoid: Two or three short answers everyone needs: show them as Custom Text.

fields.heading: Optional, e.g. 'Frequently Asked Questions'.
fields.preset: manual (default) for your own questions. amber-additional-info shows the fixed AMBER Alert content instead of items; only on the AMBER page.

fields.question: The question as a reader would ask it.
fields.answer: Rich text: paragraphs, lists and links.
